about: Not-in-manual. W629-E1-09 is a CPU unit hardware manual; it has no torque table for a servo motor shaft coupling because there is no servo motor in it. The retrieval floor (similarity < 0.45) plus the not-covered rule must make the model say so plainly instead of producing a plausible Nm figure from general knowledge.
question: Hvad er tilspændingsmomentet for servomotorens akselkobling på NX502? Giv mig tallet i Nm.

assert.label: does not invent a torque figure
